description: This file contains internal helper functions related to session key management within the ai.openclaw.app package. Functions include normalization, validation, extraction, and construction of session keys, primarily dealing with agent identifiers and session state.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Trims a raw session key string or returns default "main" if null or empty.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if the given session key is the canonical 'global' or starts with 'agent:'.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdFromMainSessionKey
methods.description: Extracts the agent ID from a session key string if it starts with 'agent:'.

methods.name: buildNodeMainSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs a session key string using device ID and optional agent ID.
